item.title: Reports: Bulls acquire Jaden Ivey, Mike Conley Jr. in 3-team trade
item.description: CHICAGO — The Chicago Bulls have acquired Pistons guard Jaden Ivey and veteran Mike Conley Jr. in a three-team trade, according to multiple reports. The Bulls sent guard Kevin Huerter and recently-acquired forward Dario Saric to the Pistons and Minnesota received a 2026 protected first-round pick. item.title: Johnson doubles down on executive order, top county prosecutor stance still unclear
item.description: Mayor Brandon Johnson's executive order to hold federal immigration agents accountable for misconduct is still under review by the Cook County States Attorney's Office, and the mayor has stressed that it is up to the State's Attorney to bring charges.

item.title: Brawl erupts at Indiana youth football tournament, adults and teens involved
item.description: A brawl broke out at a youth football tournament in Westfield, Indiana, involving adults and teenagers, resulting in one injured adult and no arrests made as of yet.

item.title: Report: Bulls trade Nikola Vucevic to Boston Celtics for Anfernee Simons, draft pick
item.description: The Chicago Bulls have traded Nikola Vucevic to the Boston Celtics in exchange for Anfernee Simons and a second-round pick.

item.title: Chicago woman recounts violent encounter with Border Patrol before Congress
item.description: Chicagoan Marimar Martinez testified before both Representatives and Senators on Capitol Hill about her violent encounter with immigration agents in Brighton Park last October.

item.title: Child shot while in car on Chicago’s Far West Side
item.description: A child is recovering after being injured in a shooting on Chicago’s Far West Side, police say.

item.title: TikTok trend leaves 9-year-old boy with severe burns from microwaved 'NeeDoh' toy
item.description: A 9-year-old boy suffered severe burns after microwaving a popular toy, the NeeDoh Nice Cube, as part of a TikTok trend, prompting Loyola Hospital's Burn Center to warn people to follow manufacturer's instructions and warnings.

item.title: Fire breaks out after Near West Side shooting leaves two dead, one injured
item.description: Two people were killed and a third was wounded in a shooting Tuesday afternoon on Chicago’s Near West Side.

item.title: Suspect arrested in fatal shooting of Kankakee County bar owner
item.description: A 30-year-old woman was found dead inside a Kankakee County bar on Monday afternoon, and her death has been ruled a homicide.
